newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Healthcare in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Healthcare in merger talks.

text.p: Integrated Healthcare Systems Inc said on Wednesday it engaged Robertson Stephens & Co Inc to help it select potential merger or acquisition candidates, adding that talks have begun with two such companies.
Integrated said the talks "are progressing on course," but no binding agreement has been signed.
Robertson is a San Francisco-based investment banking firm. Integrated Healthcare makes integrated quality and case-management software systems for the health care industry.
